verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's first-party docs show user-defined event-triggered automation. Incident Workflows offer "highly-configurable triggers and actions" with "if-this-then-that" logic, for example auto-triggering on all P1/P2 incidents. Event Orchestration rules automatically deduplicate or suppress alerts, and AI Orchestrations surface recommended rules from historical events, which also suits the AI-native persona. Workflow actions such as sending a webhook POST round out the rule-to-action loop. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of rule-definition depth (the community evidence covers only escalation behavior).
